name: acceptance-gate
description: Acceptance gate for AI-generated features. Normalizes requirements into acceptance contracts, self-generates eval cases across 4 executor types, verifies with fresh-context subagents, and enforces evidence-backed verdicts via deterministic hooks. Includes a design-quality gate (a11y/contrast, AI-slop) for web-UI surfaces. v1.16 adds the morphological-scan coverage skill (Zwicky-box AC-space enumeration with per-axis CE evidence) and a contract Coverage section surfaced on the Gate-1 card. v1.17 adds the Layout Contract discipline + layout meter (measure_layout.js) to ux-ui-craft, pairing with design-loop's layout-token-only blocking rule. v1.18 adds the S1 gap-probe: a clean-context critic probes the Gate-1 artifact set one-pass (design/contract/evals/ledger), dispositions are P0-not-silent, and the Gate-1 card renders the 'Phản biện context sạch' block with fail-visible flags, plus the gate decision commands /approve (Gate 1) and /signoff (Gate 2) and the /acceptance-report metrics aggregator (minutes vs baseline, verdict mix, gate hygiene). Cuts human acceptance time from hours to minutes. v1.19 adds the cross-layer false-green rail (wave 1): a (cross-layer) contract tag + backend-effect pairing rule + lint W4 + an advisory network-truth vocab (network_observed) in ui-check evidence with app-origin scoping, plus degradation stances for network-blind drivers (curl/mobile). v1.20 makes mobile a first-class surface (native-E2E test lane, UI-layer evidence only, W5 backend-target presence check) and gives pairing rule (c) CI teeth — pre-merge BLOCKS a (cross-layer) criterion with no layer: backend-effect eval — plus a network_observed distribution readout in /acceptance-report. v1.20.1 closes a section-scan bug class shared by four parsers (pre-merge teeth, coverage lint, gate-card, evidence-page): a `###` sub-heading inside `## Criteria` no longer truncates the scan, so criteria after it are still gated, linted and rendered on the Gate-1 card. v1.22 adds the rules ledger to pre-merge-check.sh: clean must be PROVEN — every rule block records ran/declared-off through one ledger_mark chokepoint against a fixed EXPECTED list, a machine-readable summary line (pre-merge-check: rules ran= declared-off= expected=) whose expected count is derived from EXPECTED rather than from the running totals, and any ledger mismatch is an internal-gate error (exit 2). This catches silently-skipped rule blocks that no input-validation blacklist could enumerate. v1.22.1 hardening wave: declared-but-unusable scope/filter values now exit 2 as a class (empty --base/--slug, typo'd or /-containing slug filters, PRE_MERGE_BASE set-but-empty with +x set-detection, declared base on a git-less root), an explicit --base still overrides an empty env var, VIOLATION [scope] prints on stdout like every other VIOLATION. (Repo-internal maintenance tooling also hardened — sync-plugin-packages.sh rejects extra argv — but that script ships only in the kit repo, not in this package.) v1.23 renders the Gate-2 "Ngoài hợp đồng" block on the decision card: real defects that fall outside the approved scope are shown as human work with three explicit choices (known limits / new contract / widen scope), plus the coverage-cluster flag; a review-findings.md without those sections renders exactly as before. v1.24 stops an unjudged PASS at the merge boundary: a directory that CLAIMS release (evidence declaring verdict PASS, or a contract at status implemented+) can no longer be invisible to the gate — missing contract.md, risk_tier or status is now a VIOLATION instead of a silent skip, while an abandoned scaffold stays silent by design; and a human_signoff that is a placeholder rather than a name (PENDING/TBD/TODO/n/a/none/unsigned/waiting, a bare > | -, or an unfilled <...> template) is rejected, with a NOTE stating plainly that this prefix list is short and fixed so rewording is not a fix. signoff.approvers stays informational and is deliberately NOT parsed.
